zoe: tiny bug report on Console table (compact): action icons sit over the row click area. clicked star then the row opened instead :sweat_smile:
ash: can repro on prod (mac/chrome). i think the compact token reduction removed the button padding.
priya: i'd avoid changing spacing tokens globally. options: expand hit area locally, add invisible hit target, or make row ignore clicks when pointer inside .action-area.
zoe: prefer local fix. expand hit area so visual density stays same. also ensure keyboard focus still works.
ash: quick CSS I tried:
```css
.action-btn { position: relative; }
.action-btn::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -8px; pointer-events: none; }
.action-btn { padding: 4px; }
```
priya: nice. pointer-events none on pseudo ensures focus outline unaffected. mobile: ensure min 44px tap target with touch media query.
ux-bot: accessibility reminder: add clear aria-labels to actions (e.g., "Star model") and make toast copy less ambiguous. avoid plain "Saved" 12; use "Model saved" or "Policy saved (3 changes)". use aria-live="polite" for success, assertive for errors.
ash: i'll add a cypress e2e that clicks the action then asserts no row navigation.
priya: i'll draft toast copy variants and post examples by EOD tomorrow.
zoe: thanks all. tagging @frontend for rollout. ux-bot: summary: local hit-area expansion via pseudo element or padding; keep spacing tokens; ensure 44px tap target on touch; improve toast copy to include context. :white_check_mark:
